domain_hint: RF ablation catheter tip conjugate heat transfer simulation used to predict lesion metrics under irrigated conditions
ambiguity_notes:
- Intended use and decision consequence: slides claim labeling support while kickoff and risk log say exploratory only
- Flow regime handling: setup note says laminar while solver deck enables k-omega SST with y+≈1
- Grid/time-step independence: summary claims <2% impact but detailed numbers show 5–10% differences
- Code verification: MMS claimed for conduction but also stated as not feasible for the coupled setup; reliance on vendor QA
- Validation/bench acceptance: thresholds shift from ±10%/±3 °C to ±5%/±2 °C without reconciling results that exceed them
- UQ sample size and scope: 1000 samples stated initially; actually 200; numerical uncertainties not included
- Software QA/config control: ISO 13485 cited, but untracked meshes and un-ticketed Fluent patch applied
- Reviewer independence: same person appears as reviewer and author of mesh study
